definitions.explanation: To end a business or activity.

examples.japanese: {洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{畳|たた}む。
{会社|かいしゃ}を{畳|たた}む{決断|けつだん}をした。
examples.english: I made the decision to shut down the company.

examples.japanese: {商売|しょうばい}を{畳|たた}んで{田舎|いなか}に{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: I closed the business and returned to the countryside.

notes:
{畳|たた}む is a godan verb with two distinct meanings: to fold flat objects, and to close/shut down a business.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle

SENSE 1 - TO FOLD:
- {傘|かさ}を{畳|たた}む: to close/fold an umbrella
- {布団|ふとん}を{畳|たた}む: to fold up a futon
- {洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{畳|たた}む: to fold laundry
- {服|ふく}を{畳|たた}む: to fold clothes
- {地図|ちず}を{畳|たた}む: to fold a map

SENSE 2 - TO CLOSE (business):
- {店|みせ}を{畳|たた}む: to close down a shop
- {会社|かいしゃ}を{畳|たた}む: to shut down a company
- {商売|しょうばい}を{畳|たた}む: to close a business

KANJI NOTE:
The kanji {畳|たた} is the same as {畳|たたみ} (tatami mat), reflecting the folding/layering nature of traditional Japanese flooring.
